shortDescription: Resource module for Upgrade Software Release Create

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: optionalPackages
options.description: Provide the list of optional package's id to be downloaded and upgraded. Use the `/dna/system/api/v1/releases/releaseSummary` API to obtain the optional package IDs. The `releaseName` and `releaseVersion` should correspond to the downloaded release.In the releases summary API response, optional packages can be identified by the attribute `packagesn.optional` is true. Provide the `packagesn.id` of these optional packages.

options.name: releaseName
options.description: The `releaseName` of the downloaded release to be upgraded.

options.name: releaseVersion
options.description: The `releaseVersion` of the downloaded release to be upgraded.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
